rows.NPC & MONSTER FUMBLES: The creature’s next attack suffers -20. If it’s a Magical Action, the PC receives +20 to their Spellward.
The creature becomes confused by their own inability to strike the PC, becoming Stunned for the next round.
The creature is Restrained for the next D4 rounds due to some vegetation or refuse in its vicinity.
The creature exposes a weakness in its attack pattern, granting the PC Advantage on their defensive checks for the next 2 rounds.
The attack creates a huge cloud of lifted dust, causing the PC to be Concealed for D4 rounds (or until they make an attack).
The creature trips and falls, wasting their action. It is Prone and must use its next turn to get back up.
In the process of executing its attack, the creature trips and slams its head. It is Prone and Stunned (2).
The creature manages to strike itself, receiving D6 Slashing damage.
The creature falls in an awkward position, becoming Prone and receiving 2D6 Bludgeoning damage. It must use its next turn to get back up.
